rules: No absolute path is permitted as a required dependency.
Historical path hints may appear only under provenance_hints.
A recipe that depends on nondeterministic external state is not EXACT_REPLAY and cannot certify byte-identical reconstruction.
If several artifacts satisfy a semantic role, resolution must be unambiguous by identity/version/authority constraints or fail.
ARCHIVE_COMMAND_REPLAY is exact only when the pinned archive, frozen command, runtime/source identities, and expected result hash are all explicit and verified.
